summary: Runs a fixed 256-iteration loop that walks an int pointer backward from global dword_8C5F40 in steps of 26 ints (104 bytes), invoking EmptyStub_b160 each iteration. Mirrors the pattern of the sibling 256-count loop over a different global; element semantics are unproven.

local_names.v0: current int pointer, stepped by -26 (104 bytes) per iteration

operations.description: Set v0 (esi) to the address of global dword_8C5F40.
Set v1 (edi) to the iteration count 256.
do/while loop executing exactly 256 times (v1 decremented each pass, loop continues while v1 is nonzero).
Decrement v0 by 26 ints (104 bytes) each iteration (int pointer arithmetic).
Decrement loop counter v1 by 1 each iteration.
Implicit void return after the loop terminates.

unresolved: The stepped pointer v0 is not passed to EmptyStub_b160; whether the callee reads it via another path or the pointer is vestigial is unknown.
Relationship to the parallel sibling loop (same 256-count, same 104-byte stride, different base global) is unproven.
Purpose of EmptyStub_b160 and ownership of this initialization are unknown.
